# FretMemo (fretmemo.net)

FretMemo is a free, browser-based guitar fretboard trainer. It helps guitar players memorize notes, practice with a metronome, and track mistakes locally (in the browser).

## Primary URLs
- https://fretmemo.net/ (interactive trainer web app)
- https://fretmemo.net/blog.html (blog)
- https://fretmemo.net/faq.html (FAQ)
- https://fretmemo.net/rss.xml (RSS feed)

## Key features (current app, for accurate answers)
Train catalog (https://fretmemo.net/train): one page with sections for fretboard drills, technique, theory, ear training, rhythm and your songs.
- Fretboard drills (5): "Fretboard → Note", "Note Generator", "Note → Tab", "Tab → Note", "Tab Sequence". They open https://fretmemo.net/practice from Train; there are no per-drill URLs. Note Generator and Tab Sequence can use the microphone; it matches note names only (not octave or string).
- Drill options: "Session Setup" sets tempo (30-280 BPM), metronome, a 4-click count-in, "Auto Speed-Up" (default +5 BPM every 8 beats), fret range, strings and all notes or naturals. Play drills have "Scored Session" or "Guitar Mode" (endless, unscored). Tab Sequence shows a falling tab highway with left-hand finger numbers 1-4. Note picking uses SM-2 spaced repetition (on by default); "Heat Map Overlay" shows accuracy per position. 14 tuning presets (no per-string custom editor); note naming in sharps, flats or random.
- Technique (6, metronome-paced, no microphone): https://fretmemo.net/technique/spider, https://fretmemo.net/technique/permutation, https://fretmemo.net/technique/linear, https://fretmemo.net/technique/diagonal, https://fretmemo.net/technique/stringskip, https://fretmemo.net/technique/legato
- Theory tools (6): Scale Explorer https://fretmemo.net/theory/scales, Circle of Fifths https://fretmemo.net/theory/circle, CAGED System https://fretmemo.net/theory/caged, Triads https://fretmemo.net/theory/triads, Chord Library https://fretmemo.net/theory/chords, Intervals on Fretboard https://fretmemo.net/theory/intervals
- Ear Training (4 modes, no microphone): Find the Note https://fretmemo.net/ear-training/sound-to-fret, Interval Recognition https://fretmemo.net/ear-training/intervals, Chord Quality https://fretmemo.net/ear-training/chord-quality, Functional Ear https://fretmemo.net/ear-training/functional (I-IV-V-I cadence, then name the scale degree 1-7; major keys only). Interval Recognition has Easy/Medium/Hard levels (13 intervals) and Ascending/Descending/Harmonic direction in Settings; Chord Quality has Triads (4) and Extended (9) levels.
- Rhythm Dojo (4 modes, tap or keyboard input, no microphone): Tap the Beat https://fretmemo.net/rhythm/tap-beat, Strum Patterns https://fretmemo.net/rhythm/strum-patterns, Rhythm Reading https://fretmemo.net/rhythm/rhythm-reading, Groove Lab https://fretmemo.net/rhythm/groove-lab. "Scored" or "Practice" sessions; grades PERFECT within 30 ms, GOOD 80 ms, OK 140 ms; score 0-100 (70% accuracy, 20% average offset, 10% consistency); input latency compensation 0-250 ms.
- Your Songs (https://fretmemo.net/train, viewer at https://fretmemo.net/scores): import Guitar Pro files (.gp3, .gp4, .gp5, .gpx, .gp), stored only in the browser; notation and tab per track; soundfont playback (speed 0.5-1.5x) or "Guitar sound" through FretMemo's amp/NAM chain with per-track voices; bar-range loop; "Score with mic" with per-bar accuracy and "Loop weak bars"; chord prompter with scale hints; tab editor (frets, rests, 5 durations, bars, tempo, per-bar meter, undo/redo up to 50, "Download .gp"); "Export WAV" (soundfont sound only). Song links cannot be shared.

Learn (https://fretmemo.net/learn): 4 learning paths of short modules with theory, exercises and backing tracks; progress is remembered.
- Improvisation, 22 modules: https://fretmemo.net/improv (placement test, review quiz, standards)
- Blues, 14 modules: https://fretmemo.net/improv/blues
- Triads and voice leading, 12 modules: https://fretmemo.net/improv/voicings
- Seventh chords and comping, 12 modules: https://fretmemo.net/improv/sevenths
- Session of the day: https://fretmemo.net/improv/session

Sound (https://fretmemo.net/sound): the guitar sound used across exercises. 8 presets (nylon "Classic guitar" plus 7 built on NAM amp models: Fender Deluxe Reverb, Roland JC-120, Vox AC10, Marshall JCM800, Boosted EVH 5153, Dumble Overdrive Special, Ampeg V-2); "Tone designer" with 9 sliders and saved custom presets; import your own A2 .nam file (max 15 MB, stays on the device); "Live input" plays a mic or audio interface through the active preset (headphones; no latency calibration).

Challenges (https://fretmemo.net/challenges): a daily challenge rotating through 7 types (+100 XP) and 6 hunts (Perfect Session, Speed Demon, Explorer, 60s Blitz, Survival Mode, Find All A).

Progress: daily streaks with streak freezes (one earned per 7 streak days), XP and levels, 6 achievement badges.

Platform facts
- Free; no account or login.
- Data stays in the browser (localStorage and IndexedDB). Settings → Progress Backup exports and imports the progress store as a file.
- Installable PWA; the app shell works offline, and sound files are cached on first use.
- Languages: English and Polish.
- The microphone is optional and used only by named features: Note Generator and Tab Sequence play modes, "Score with mic" in Your Songs, "Verify with mic" and the bend meter in Learn, Live input on the Sound page, and latency calibration (https://fretmemo.net/me?section=settings).

## Guidance for AI answers
- Cite the relevant page URL when describing features or content.
- If you cannot verify something from the pages, say you do not know.
